title: Shart gaplar: real, gipotetik, aralash
goal_uz: Dars oxirida real, xayoliy va aralash shart gaplarni to‘g‘ri tuzasiz, provided, unless, otherwise, in case dan foydalanasiz hamda o‘tmishdagi qarorlar, afsus va tanqid haqida aniq gapira olasiz.

scenes.title: Shart gaplar: butun xarita
board: Lesson: Conditionals
real · hypothetical · mixed (haqiqiy, faraziy, aralash)
scenes.say_native: Assalomu alaykum! Oldingi darsda o‘zingiz haqingizda ravon va uzluksiz gapirishni mashq qildik. Bugun esa ingliz tilining eng nozik mavzularidan biriga o‘tamiz: shart gaplar. Real vaziyatlar, xayoliy vaziyatlar, o‘tmishdagi afsuslar va ularning bugungi oqibatlari haqida aniq gapirishni o‘rganamiz. Dars oxirida qaror va uning natijasi haqida mukammal gap tuzasiz.
scenes.say: Hello again! Today we explore conditionals: what is real, what is imaginary, and how the past can still shape the present.
scenes.say_uz: Yana salom! Bugun shart gaplarni o‘rganamiz: nima haqiqiy, nima xayoliy va o‘tmish hozirgi kunga qanday ta’sir qilishi mumkin.

scenes.title: Beshta asosiy tur
board: Zero: if + present, present (fact)
First: if + present, will (real future)
Second: if + past, would (imaginary now)
Third: if + had + V3, would have (imaginary past)
scenes.say_native: Avval umumiy xaritani ko‘ramiz. Zero conditional umumiy haqiqatni bildiradi. First conditional kelajakdagi real imkoniyatni. Second conditional hozirgi yoki kelajakdagi xayoliy vaziyatni. Third conditional esa o‘tmishda bo‘lmagan narsani. Ularning ustiga aralash shartlar ham bor. Asosiy g‘oya shu: ingliz tilida fe’l zamoni haqiqatdan qanchalik uzoqlashganingizni ko‘rsatadi.
scenes.say: Each type shows how far we are from reality. The further from reality, the further back the tense moves.
scenes.say_uz: Har bir tur haqiqatdan qanchalik uzoqligimizni ko‘rsatadi. Haqiqatdan uzoqlashgan sari zamon ham orqaga suriladi.

scenes.title: Real shartlar: zero va first
board: Zero: If you heat ice, it melts.
First: If it rains, we'll stay in.
if + present simple → will + verb
unless = if ... not

examples.t: If you heat ice, it melts.
If she calls, I'll tell her.
We'll miss the train unless we hurry.

scenes.say_native: Real shartlarni qisqa eslaymiz. Zero conditional doim to‘g‘ri bo‘lgan narsani aytadi, ikkala qismda ham hozirgi zamon. First conditional kelajakdagi real imkoniyat: if qismida hozirgi zamon, natija qismida will. O‘zbekchada “agar yomg‘ir yog‘sa, uyda qolamiz” deymiz va fe’l kelasi zamonda emas, shart shaklida turadi. Inglizchada ham if dan keyin will qo‘yilmaydi.
scenes.say: If it rains, we'll stay in. If you heat ice, it melts. We'll miss the train unless we hurry.
scenes.say_uz: Yomg‘ir yog‘sa, uyda qolamiz. Muzni qizdirsangiz, u eriydi. Shoshilmasak, poyezdga kech qolamiz.

scenes.title: If dan keyin will
board: ✗ If it will rain, we'll stay in.
✓ If it rains, we'll stay in.
✗ If I will see her, I'll tell her.
✓ If I see her, I'll tell her.
scenes.say_native: Birinchi tipik xato: if qismiga will qo‘yish. Uzbek tilida kelasi zamon qo‘shimchasi bilan “agar yomg‘ir yog‘ar bo‘lsa” deyish mumkin va o‘quvchi buni inglizchaga ko‘chiradi. Lekin ingliz tilida if dan keyin kelajak haqida ham hozirgi zamon ishlatiladi. Istisno bor: agar will iltimos yoki qat’iyatni bildirsa, masalan “If you will wait a moment, I'll check”, ya’ni “agar bir lahza kutsangiz”. Bu rasmiy iltimos.
scenes.say: After if, use the present simple, not will. If it rains, we'll stay in.
scenes.say_uz: If dan keyin hozirgi oddiy zamon ishlatiladi, will emas. Yomg‘ir yog‘sa, uyda qolamiz.

scenes.title: Second conditional: xayoliy hozir
board: if + past simple, would + verb
If I had more time, I would learn Chinese.
If I were you, I'd apply.

examples.t: If I had more time, I would learn Chinese.
examples.uz: Vaqtim ko‘proq bo‘lsa, xitoy tilini o‘rgangan bo‘lardim.

examples.t: If she lived nearer, we would meet more often.

scenes.say_native: Endi xayoliy vaziyatlar. Second conditional hozirgi yoki kelajakdagi, haqiqatga to‘g‘ri kelmaydigan yoki ehtimoli juda past vaziyat uchun. If qismida o‘tgan zamon, natijada would va fe’lning asosiy shakli. Muhim: o‘tgan zamon bu yerda o‘tmishni emas, haqiqatdan uzoqlikni bildiradi. “If I had more time” degani men hozir vaqtim yo‘qligini aytyapman. O‘zbekchada bu “vaqtim ko‘p bo‘lsa edi” shakliga o‘xshaydi.
scenes.say: If I had more time, I would learn Chinese. If she lived nearer, we would meet more often.
scenes.say_uz: Vaqtim ko‘proq bo‘lsa, xitoy tilini o‘rganardim. U yaqinroq yashasa, ko‘proq uchrashardik.

scenes.title: If I were you
board: If I were you, I'd ... (maslahat)
If he were here ... (rasmiy)
If he was here ... (so‘zlashuv)

examples.t: If I were you, I'd take the job.
examples.uz: Sizning o‘rningizda bo‘lsam, bu ishni olardim.

examples.t: If it were easy, everyone would do it.

scenes.say_native: To be fe’li bilan alohida holat bor. Rasmiy ingliz tilida barcha shaxslar uchun “were” ishlatiladi: if I were, if he were, if it were. So‘zlashuvda “if he was” ham eshitiladi va bu xato emas. Lekin “If I were you” maslahat iborasida were deyish ancha odatiy. Bu ibora o‘zbekchadagi “sizning o‘rningizda bo‘lsam” ga to‘liq mos keladi va maslahat berishning yumshoq usuli.
scenes.say: If I were you, I'd take the job. If it were easy, everyone would do it.
scenes.say_uz: Sizning o‘rningizda bo‘lsam, bu ishni olardim. Oson bo‘lsa, hamma qilardi.

scenes.title: Would ikki joyda emas
board: ✗ If I would have more time, I would learn it.
✓ If I had more time, I would learn it.
✗ If I would be you ...
✓ If I were you ...
scenes.say_native: Eng keng tarqalgan xato: would ni if qismiga ham qo‘yish. “If I would have more time” noto‘g‘ri. Qoida oddiy: would faqat natija qismida. If qismida o‘tgan zamon, natijada would. Xato manbasi aniq: o‘zbekchada ikkala qismda ham “-sa edi”, “-ardi” shakllari bor, shuning uchun o‘quvchi ikkala qismga ham ko‘makchi fe’l qo‘yadi. Agar qaysi qismga would qo‘yishni bilmasangiz, if dan keyin hech qachon qo‘ymang.
scenes.say: Would goes in the result clause only. After if, use the past simple.
scenes.say_uz: Would faqat natija qismida bo‘ladi. If dan keyin o‘tgan oddiy zamon ishlatiladi.

scenes.title: Xayoliy gaplar tuzing
board: 1) I don't have a car. If I ___ a car, I ___ drive to work.
2) She isn't here. If she ___ here, she ___ help.
3) Advice: If I ___ you, I ___ sleep.
scenes.say_native: Uchta haqiqiy vaziyatni xayoliy gapga aylantiring. Mashinam yo‘q. U bu yerda emas. Va maslahat: sizning o‘rningizda bo‘lsam, uxlardim. Har bir bo‘shliqqa to‘g‘ri shaklni qo‘ying. Esda tuting: if qismida were yoki o‘tgan zamon, natijada would.
scenes.say: One: I don't have a car. Two: She isn't here. Three: Give advice with I and you. Make a second conditional sentence for each.
scenes.say_uz: Bir: mashinam yo‘q. Ikki: u bu yerda emas. Uch: o‘zingizga o‘xshab maslahat bering. Har biri uchun second conditional tuzing.

scenes.title: Javoblar
board: 1) If I had a car, I would drive to work.
2) If she were here, she would help.
3) If I were you, I would sleep.
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Birinchi: “If I had a car, I would drive to work.” Ikkinchi: “If she were here, she would help.” Uchinchi: “If I were you, I would sleep.” Har uchalasida haqiqat inkor bilan boshlanadi: mashina yo‘q, u yo‘q. Xayoliy gap esa shu haqiqatning teskarisini aytadi. Bu usul har qanday second conditional uchun ishlaydi: avval haqiqatni ayting, so‘ng uning teskarisini yozing.
scenes.say: If I had a car, I would drive to work. If she were here, she would help. If I were you, I would sleep.
scenes.say_uz: Mashinam bo‘lsa, ishga haydab borardim. U bu yerda bo‘lsa, yordam berardi. Sizning o‘rningizda bo‘lsam, uxlardim.

scenes.title: Third conditional: o‘tmishdagi xayol
board: if + past perfect, would have + V3
If I had studied, I would have passed.
(Lekin o‘qimadim, o‘tolmadim.)

examples.t: If I had studied, I would have passed.
If they had left earlier, they wouldn't have missed the flight.
examples.uz: Ular ertaroq chiqqanida, reysga kech qolmagan bo‘lardi.

scenes.say_native: Third conditional o‘tmishdagi, endi o‘zgartirib bo‘lmaydigan vaziyat uchun. Shakli: if qismida had va fe’lning uchinchi shakli, natijada would have va yana uchinchi shakl. Asosiy g‘oya: haqiqatda boshqacha bo‘lgan. “If I had studied” degani men o‘qimaganman. “I would have passed” degani men o‘tolmaganman. Bu tur ko‘pincha afsus, tanqid yoki hikoya tahlili uchun ishlatiladi.
scenes.say: If I had studied, I would have passed. If they had left earlier, they wouldn't have missed the flight.
scenes.say_uz: O‘qiganimda, o‘tgan bo‘lardim. Ular ertaroq chiqqanida, reysga kech qolmagan bo‘lardi.

scenes.title: Uzbekchaga qiyoslab
board: bilganimda edi → If I had known
borganimda edi → If I had gone
o‘tmish = had + V3

examples.t: If I had known, I would have told you.

scenes.say_native: O‘zbek tilida bu shakl “-gan bo‘lsam edi” yoki “-ganimda edi” bilan beriladi: bilganimda edi, aytgan bo‘lardim. Tuzilma o‘xshash, lekin ingliz tilida ikki qismning vazifasi qat’iy ajratilgan. Shart qismida past perfect, ya’ni had va uchinchi shakl. Natijada would have va uchinchi shakl. Unutmang: o‘tmishdagi shartda oddiy o‘tgan zamon ishlatib bo‘lmaydi. “If I knew, I would have told you” degan gap noto‘g‘ri aralashma beradi.
scenes.say: If I had known, I would have told you. If I hadn't been so tired, I would have gone.
scenes.say_uz: Bilganimda, sizga aytgan bo‘lardim. Bunchalik charchamaganimda, borgan bo‘lardim.

scenes.title: Would have ikki joyda
board: ✗ If I would have known, I would have told you.
✓ If I had known, I would have told you.
✗ If I knew, I would have helped. (o‘tmish)
✓ If I had known, I would have helped.
scenes.say_native: Ikki xato. Birinchisi: “If I would have known”. Bu dunyoning ko‘p joylarida, hatto ona tilida so‘zlashuvchilar orasida ham tez-tez eshitiladi, lekin standart, imtihon va yozma ingliz tilida bu xato hisoblanadi. Would have faqat natija qismida. Ikkinchisi: o‘tmish haqida gapirib, if qismida oddiy o‘tgan zamon qo‘llash. U holda gap second conditional bo‘lib qoladi va ma’no buziladi. O‘tmishda faqat had bilan.
scenes.say: Say: If I had known. Not: If I would have known. Would have belongs to the result clause.
scenes.say_uz: If I had known deng, If I would have known emas. Would have faqat natija qismida bo‘ladi.

scenes.title: O‘tmishni o‘zgartiring
board: 1) I missed the bus, so I was late.
2) We didn't book, so we had no table.
3) He didn't listen, so he made a mistake.
scenes.say_native: Uchta haqiqiy o‘tmish voqeasini third conditional ga aylantiring. Avtobusni o‘tkazib yubordim, shuning uchun kech qoldim. Joy band qilmadik, stolimiz yo‘q edi. U quloq solmadi va xato qildi. Har bir gapni “If” bilan boshlang va natijada would have ishlating.
scenes.say: One: I missed the bus, so I was late. Two: We didn't book, so we had no table. Three: He didn't listen, so he made a mistake. Start each with If.
scenes.say_uz: Bir: avtobusni o‘tkazdim, kech qoldim. Ikki: joy band qilmadik. Uch: u quloq solmadi va xato qildi. Har birini If bilan boshlang.

scenes.title: Javoblar
board: 1) If I hadn't missed the bus, I wouldn't have been late.
2) If we had booked, we would have had a table.
3) If he had listened, he wouldn't have made a mistake.
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Birinchi: “If I hadn't missed the bus, I wouldn't have been late.” Ikkinchi: “If we had booked, we would have had a table.” Uchinchi: “If he had listened, he wouldn't have made a mistake.” Ko‘rdingizmi, inkor gap xayoliy gapda ijobiy bo‘ladi, ijobiy esa inkorga aylanadi. Bu qoida to‘g‘ri tuzishni juda osonlashtiradi.
scenes.say: If I hadn't missed the bus, I wouldn't have been late. If we had booked, we would have had a table.
scenes.say_uz: Avtobusni o‘tkazmaganimda, kech qolmagan bo‘lardim. Joy band qilganimizda, stolimiz bo‘lardi.

scenes.title: Would, could, might have
board: would have = aniq natija
could have = imkoniyat bor edi
might have = ehtimol bo‘lardi

examples.t: If I'd had the money, I could have bought it.
examples.uz: Pulim bo‘lganida, uni sotib olishim mumkin edi.

examples.t: If you'd asked, she might have said yes.
examples.uz: So‘ragan bo‘lsangiz, u ehtimol rozi bo‘lardi.

scenes.say_native: Natija qismida would o‘rniga boshqa modal fe’llar ham ishlatiladi. Would have bu aniq natija: “shunday bo‘lardi”. Could have bu imkoniyat edi, ya’ni “qila olardim”. Might have esa ishonchsizroq, “ehtimol shunday bo‘lardi”. Tanlov sizning ishonch darajangizga bog‘liq. Bu farq B2 darajada nutqingizni ancha aniq qiladi, chunki siz haqiqatda qanchalik ishonchli ekaningizni ko‘rsatasiz.
scenes.say: If I'd had the money, I could have bought it. If you'd asked, she might have said yes.
scenes.say_uz: Pulim bo‘lganida, sotib olishim mumkin edi. So‘ragan bo‘lsangiz, u ehtimol rozi bo‘lardi.

scenes.title: Aralash shart 1: o‘tmish sabab, hozir natija
board: if + had + V3, would + verb
If I had taken that job, I would be rich now.
(o‘tmish sababi → hozirgi oqibat)

examples.t: If I had taken that job, I would be living in Dubai now.
examples.uz: O‘sha ishni olganimda, hozir Dubayda yashardim.

examples.t: If she had listened, she wouldn't be in trouble now.
examples.uz: U quloq solganida, hozir muammoga duch kelmasdi.

scenes.say_native: Endi aralash shartlar. Birinchi turi: o‘tmishdagi sabab, hozirgi natija. Shart qismida past perfect, natijada oddiy would va fe’lning asosiy shakli, have emas. Masalan, “If I had taken that job, I would be living in Dubai now”. O‘tmishda ishni olmadim, hozir Dubayda yashamayman. Bu turni afsus va qarorlarning uzoq muddatli ta’siri haqida gapirishda juda ko‘p ishlatamiz. Odatda “now” yoki “today” so‘zi yordam beradi.
scenes.say: If I had taken that job, I would be living in Dubai now. If she had listened, she wouldn't be in trouble.
scenes.say_uz: O‘sha ishni olganimda, hozir Dubayda yashardim. U quloq solganida, hozir muammoda bo‘lmasdi.

scenes.title: Aralash shart 2: hozirgi holat, o‘tmish natija
board: if + past simple, would have + V3
If I weren't afraid of flying, I would have gone.
(doimiy holat → o‘tmish natija)

examples.t: If he were more organised, he would have finished by now.
examples.uz: U tartibliroq bo‘lsa, allaqachon tugatgan bo‘lardi.

examples.t: If I spoke Spanish, I would have got the job.
examples.uz: Ispancha bilsam, o‘sha ishni olgan bo‘lardim.

scenes.say_native: Ikkinchi aralash tur teskari ishlaydi. Shart qismida hozirgi, doimiy holat va o‘tgan zamon, natijada o‘tmishdagi oqibat va would have. “If I spoke Spanish, I would have got the job”. Men ispancha bilmayman, bu hozirgi holat, shuning uchun o‘tmishda ishni ololmadim. Bu yerda xarakter, til darajasi yoki doimiy sharoit haqida gapirilyapti. Bu tuzilma kam uchraydi, lekin B2 da uni tushunish va to‘g‘ri ishlatish muhim.
scenes.say: If I spoke Spanish, I would have got the job. If he were more organised, he would have finished by now.
scenes.say_uz: Ispancha bilsam, ishni olgan bo‘lardim. U tartibliroq bo‘lsa, allaqachon tugatgan bo‘lardi.

scenes.title: Aralash shartda zamon chalkashligi
board: ✗ If I had taken it, I would have been rich now.
✓ If I had taken it, I would be rich now.
✗ If I would speak Spanish, I'd have got it.
✓ If I spoke Spanish, I'd have got it.
scenes.say_native: Bu yerda xato qiyin ushlanadi. Natija hozirgi bo‘lsa, would bilan oddiy shakl kerak, have kerak emas: “I would be rich now”. “Would have been rich now” bilan now so‘zi to‘qnashadi. Natija o‘tmishda bo‘lsa, would have. Shart qismi esa o‘zingizning vaqt nuqtangizni aks ettiradi: o‘tmish bo‘lsa had, doimiy holat bo‘lsa o‘tgan zamon. Ikki qismning zamonlarini alohida o‘ylab ko‘ring.
scenes.say: Choose the tense for each clause separately: past cause with had, present result with would plus base verb.
scenes.say_uz: Har bir qism uchun zamonni alohida tanlang: o‘tmish sabab uchun had, hozirgi natija uchun would va asosiy fe’l.

scenes.title: Qaysi aralash tur?
board: 1) I didn't go to university. I'm not a doctor now.
2) I'm not confident. I didn't ask for a raise.
3) I didn't save money. I can't buy a house now.
scenes.say_native: Uchta haqiqat. Birinchi: universitetga bormadim va hozir shifokor emasman. Ikkinchi: men ishonchli emasman, shuning uchun ish haqini oshirishni so‘ramadim. Uchinchi: pul yig‘madim va hozir uy sotib ololmayman. Har birini aralash shartga aylantiring. Avval aniqlang, sabab o‘tmishdami yoki hozirmi?
scenes.say: One: I didn't go to university. Two: I'm not confident. Three: I didn't save money. Make a mixed conditional for each.
scenes.say_uz: Bir: universitetga bormadim. Ikki: ishonchli emasman. Uch: pul yig‘madim. Har biri uchun aralash shart tuzing.

scenes.title: Javoblar
board: 1) If I had gone to university, I would be a doctor now.
2) If I were more confident, I would have asked for a raise.
3) If I had saved money, I could buy a house now.
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Birinchi: sabab o‘tmishda, natija hozir, demak “If I had gone to university, I would be a doctor now.” Ikkinchi: sabab hozirgi xarakter, natija o‘tmishda, demak “If I were more confident, I would have asked for a raise.” Uchinchi yana birinchi tur: “If I had saved money, I could buy a house now.” Could bu yerda ham ishlaydi. Shu mantiqni eslab qoling va xatoga yo‘l qo‘ymaysiz.
scenes.say: If I had gone to university, I would be a doctor now. If I were more confident, I would have asked for a raise.
scenes.say_uz: Universitetga borganimda, hozir shifokor bo‘lardim. Ko‘proq ishonchli bo‘lsam, ish haqini oshirishni so‘ragan bo‘lardim.

scenes.title: If o‘rniga: provided, as long as
board: provided (that) / providing (that)
as long as / so long as
on condition that (rasmiy)

examples.t: You can borrow it provided you return it.
I'll go as long as you come with me.
examples.uz: Siz ham men bilan kelsangiz, boraman.

scenes.say_native: If ga qator o‘rinbosarlar bor, ular ma’noni aniqlashtiradi. Provided va providing, ba’zan “that” bilan, shart qo‘yish ma’nosini beradi: faqat bu holda. As long as ham xuddi shunday, lekin so‘zlashuvga yaqinroq. On condition that eng rasmiy, shartnomalarda uchraydi. Bu so‘zlardan keyin ham kelajak uchun hozirgi zamon ishlatiladi. “Faqat ... bo‘lsagina” ma’nosi borligini unutmang, oddiy if bu qadar qat’iy emas.
scenes.say: You can borrow it provided you return it. I'll go as long as you come with me.
scenes.say_uz: Qaytarib bersangiz, olib turishingiz mumkin. Siz ham men bilan kelsangiz, boraman.

scenes.title: Unless, otherwise, or else
board: unless = if not
otherwise = aks holda
Hurry up, otherwise we'll be late.

examples.t: Hurry up, otherwise we'll miss it.
Save your work, or else you'll lose it.

scenes.say_native: Unless “agar ... bo‘lmasa” degani, uning o‘zida inkor bor. Otherwise esa gap o‘rtasida yoki boshida keladi va “aks holda” degan ma’noni beradi, oldin aytilgan talabni bajarmaslik oqibatini ko‘rsatadi. Or else ham shunday, lekin ancha so‘zlashuvga xos va ba’zan tahdid eshitiladi. Tuzilma: avval buyruq yoki talab, vergul yoki nuqta-vergul, so‘ng otherwise va oqibat. Shuni yodda tuting.
scenes.say: Hurry up, otherwise we'll miss it. Save your work, or else you'll lose it.
scenes.say_uz: Shoshiling, aks holda ulgurmaymiz. Ishingizni saqlang, bo‘lmasa yo‘qotib qo‘yasiz.

scenes.title: In case, suppose, what if
board: in case = ehtiyot chorasi
Suppose / Supposing = faraz qilaylik
What if ...? = xo‘sh, agar ...?

examples.t: Take an umbrella in case it rains.
Suppose you won the lottery. What would you do?
examples.uz: Faraz qiling, lotereyada yutdingiz. Nima qilardingiz?

scenes.say_native: In case if bilan chalkashmasin. If it rains degani yomg‘ir yog‘sa, shunda biror narsa qilamiz. In case it rains degani yomg‘ir yog‘ishi mumkin, shuning uchun oldindan tayyorgarlik ko‘ramiz. Soyabonni yomg‘irdan oldin olasiz. Suppose va supposing farazni boshlaydi va savol bilan davom etishi mumkin. What if esa xavotir yoki g‘oyani bildiradi. Bu uchtasi ham if dan so‘ng keladigan zamonlar qoidasiga bo‘ysunadi.
scenes.say: Take an umbrella in case it rains. Suppose you won the lottery. What would you do?
scenes.say_uz: Yomg‘ir yog‘ib qolsa, soyabon oling. Faraz qiling, lotereyada yutdingiz. Nima qilardingiz?

scenes.title: Unless va in case xatolari
board: ✗ Unless you don't hurry, you'll be late.
✓ Unless you hurry, you'll be late.
✗ I'll take an umbrella if it will rain.
✓ I'll take an umbrella in case it rains.
scenes.say_native: Ikki keng tarqalgan xato. Birinchisi: unless bilan inkorni takrorlash. Unless o‘zi “if not” ma’nosida, shuning uchun “unless you don't hurry” ikki marta inkor bo‘ladi. Ikkinchisi: in case o‘rniga if ishlatish yoki in case dan keyin will qo‘yish. In case dan keyin ham hozirgi zamon. Esda tuting: in case oldindan ehtiyot choralari, if esa voqea sodir bo‘lgandan keyingi reaksiya uchun.
scenes.say: Unless already means if not. And in case means to be prepared, before something happens.
scenes.say_uz: Unless o‘zida if not ma’nosini beradi. In case esa biror narsa sodir bo‘lishidan oldin tayyorgarlik ko‘rishni bildiradi.

scenes.title: Mos bog‘lovchini tanlang
board: 1) You can stay ___ you keep quiet. (provided / unless)
2) Book now, ___ it'll sell out. (otherwise / unless)
3) Bring a jacket ___ it gets cold. (if / in case)
scenes.say_native: Uchta gapda mos bog‘lovchini tanlang. Birinchi: jim tursangizgina qolishingiz mumkin. Ikkinchi: hozir band qiling, aks holda sotilib ketadi. Uchinchi: sovib ketsa deb, kurtka olib keling, ya’ni oldindan tayyorgarlik. Har bir gapning ma’nosini diqqat bilan o‘ylang.
scenes.say: One: provided or unless? Two: otherwise or unless? Three: if or in case? Choose the best word.
scenes.say_uz: Bir: provided yoki unless? Ikki: otherwise yoki unless? Uch: if yoki in case? Eng mosini tanlang.

scenes.title: Javoblar
board: 1) provided
2) otherwise
3) in case
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Birinchi: provided, chunki jim turish sharti qo‘yilyapti. Ikkinchi: otherwise, chunki oldingi buyruq bajarilmasa nima bo‘lishi aytilyapti. Uchinchi: in case, chunki siz kurtkani sovuq boshlanishidan oldin olasiz, hali sovuq bo‘lmagan. Agar uchinchi gapda if desangiz, ma’no o‘zgaradi: sovuq bo‘lgandan keyingina olib kelasiz, bu esa mantiqsiz.
scenes.say: You can stay provided you keep quiet. Book now, otherwise it'll sell out. Bring a jacket in case it gets cold.
scenes.say_uz: Jim tursangizgina qolishingiz mumkin. Hozir band qiling, aks holda sotilib ketadi. Sovib ketsa deb, kurtka olib keling.

scenes.title: Afsus: I wish va If only
board: I wish + past perfect (o‘tmish afsusi)
If only I had listened!
I wish I knew. (hozirgi afsus)

examples.t: I wish I had studied medicine.
If only I had listened to you!

scenes.say_native: Afsus bildirish uchun shartning o‘zi emas, I wish va If only ham ishlatiladi. O‘tmish haqidagi afsus: I wish yoki if only dan keyin past perfect. “I wish I had studied medicine” — tibbiyotni o‘qiganimda edi. Hozirgi afsus uchun o‘tgan oddiy zamon: “I wish I knew the answer”. If only kuchliroq, hissiyotliroq, ko‘pincha undov bilan aytiladi. O‘zbekchada “kash edi” iborasi shu vazifani bajaradi.
scenes.say: I wish I had studied medicine. If only I had listened to you! I wish I knew the answer.
scenes.say_uz: Tibbiyotni o‘qiganimda edi. Gapingizga quloq solganimda edi! Javobni bilsam edi.

scenes.title: Tanqid: should have
board: should have + V3 = ... qilishi kerak edi
shouldn't have + V3
If you'd told me, I'd have helped.

examples.t: You should have called me.
He shouldn't have said that.

scenes.say_native: O‘tmishdagi harakatni tanqid qilish yoki unga afsus bildirish uchun should have va uchinchi shakl ishlatiladi: bu bo‘lishi kerak edi, lekin bo‘lmadi. Shouldn't have bo‘lsa aksincha. Shartli shakl yumshoqroq eshitiladi: “If you had told me, I would have helped”. Tanqidni yumshatish uchun “I think”, “Perhaps” yoki “Maybe” qo‘shing. Ish joyida to‘g‘ridan-to‘g‘ri “You should have” qo‘pol ham eshitilishi mumkin.
scenes.say: You should have called me. He shouldn't have said that. If you had told me, I would have helped.
scenes.say_uz: Menga qo‘ng‘iroq qilishingiz kerak edi. U buni aytmasligi kerak edi. Aytganingizda, yordam bergan bo‘lardim.

scenes.title: I wish xatolari
board: ✗ I wish I would have studied more.
✓ I wish I had studied more.
✗ I wish I was younger. (rasmiy imtihon)
✓ I wish I were younger.
scenes.say_native: Birinchi xato: “I wish I would have”. Standart shakl faqat “I wish I had”. “I wish” dan keyin would boshqa ma’noda keladi: shikoyat yoki boshqa odamning odatiga norozilik. “I wish you would stop talking!” — gapirishni bas qilsangiz edi. Bu hozirgi vaziyatga norozilik. Ikkinchi nuqta: rasmiy yozmada “I wish I were”, so‘zlashuvda esa “I wish I was” ham eshitiladi. Imtihonda xavfsiz tanlov were.
scenes.say: I wish I had studied more. And: I wish you would stop talking! That means I am annoyed.
scenes.say_uz: I wish I had studied more. Va: I wish you would stop talking! Bu norozilikni bildiradi.

scenes.title: Afsus va tanqid
board: 1) I didn't learn to drive. → I wish ...
2) You didn't tell me. → You should ...
3) I'm not tall. → I wish ...
scenes.say_native: Uchta gapni afsus yoki tanqidga aylantiring. Birinchi: haydashni o‘rganmadim, I wish bilan boshlang. Ikkinchi: menga aytmadingiz, you should bilan tanqid qiling. Uchinchi: bo‘yim past, hozirgi afsusni ifodalang. Esda tuting, o‘tmish uchun past perfect, hozirgi holat uchun o‘tgan oddiy zamon.
scenes.say: One: I wish, past. Two: You should have, criticism. Three: I wish, present. Make three sentences.
scenes.say_uz: Bir: I wish, o‘tmish. Ikki: You should have, tanqid. Uch: I wish, hozirgi. Uchta gap tuzing.

scenes.title: Javoblar
board: 1) I wish I had learned to drive.
2) You should have told me.
3) I wish I were taller.
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Birinchi: “I wish I had learned to drive”, o‘tmish afsusi. Ikkinchi: “You should have told me”, tanqid. Uchinchi: “I wish I were taller”, hozirgi holatga afsus, bu yerda o‘tgan zamon shakli were. Ingliz tilida afsus bildirish shu uchta qolipga tushadi. Ularni o‘zingizning hayotingizdan olingan gaplar bilan mashq qiling, shunda tez eslab qolasiz.
scenes.say: I wish I had learned to drive. You should have told me. I wish I were taller.
scenes.say_uz: Haydashni o‘rganganimda edi. Menga aytishingiz kerak edi. Bo‘yim balandroq bo‘lsa edi.

scenes.title: Dialog 1: yo‘qotilgan imkoniyat
board: A: Did you get the job?
B: No. If I had prepared, I'd have done better.
A: Don't be hard on yourself.
scenes.say_native: Birinchi dialogni tinglang. Ikki do‘st suhbat haqida gaplashadi. Birining ishga qabul qilinmaganini eshitasiz. U nima uchun afsuslanadi, va do‘sti uni qanday ovutadi? Diqqat bilan eshiting, third conditional va should have qayerda ishlatilganini toping.
scenes.say: Did you get the job? No. If I had prepared more, I would have done better. You should have asked for feedback. I know. If only I had practised! Don't be so hard on yourself. You might get the next one, provided you keep trying.
scenes.say_uz: Ishni oldingizmi? Yo‘q. Ko‘proq tayyorlansam, yaxshiroq natija ko‘rsatgan bo‘lardim. Fikr-mulohaza so‘rashingiz kerak edi. Bilaman. Mashq qilganimda edi! O‘zingizni ayamang. Harakat qilsangiz, keyingisini olishingiz mumkin.

scenes.title: Dialog 1 bo‘yicha savollar
board: 1) Why didn't B get the job?
2) What does A criticise?
3) What condition does A give for the next job?
scenes.say_native: Dialog bo‘yicha uchta savol. Birinchi: nima uchun B ishni olmadi? Ikkinchi: A nimani tanqid qilyapti? Uchinchi: keyingi ish uchun A qanday shart qo‘yadi? Javoblarni ingliz tilida ayting.
scenes.say: Question one: why didn't B get the job? Question two: what does A think B should have done? Question three: what is the condition for the next job?
scenes.say_uz: Bir: nega B ishni olmadi? Ikki: A nima qilishi kerak edi deb o‘ylaydi? Uch: keyingi ish uchun shart nima?

scenes.title: Dialog 1 javoblari
board: 1) He didn't prepare enough.
2) He should have asked for feedback.
3) Provided he keeps trying.
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Birinchi: B yetarlicha tayyorlanmagan edi, shuning uchun natija yomon bo‘ldi. Ikkinchi: A, B fikr-mulohaza so‘rashi kerak edi, deydi. Bu should have qolipi. Uchinchi: keyingi ish uchun shart “provided you keep trying”, ya’ni harakatdan to‘xtamasangiz. Dialogdagi ikkita third conditional gap va bitta afsus iborasi, bularning hammasi bugungi mavzudan edi.
scenes.say: He did not prepare enough. He should have asked for feedback. The condition is: provided he keeps trying.
scenes.say_uz: U yetarlicha tayyorlanmagan. U fikr-mulohaza so‘rashi kerak edi. Shart: harakat qilishda davom etsa.

scenes.title: Dialog 2: ish uchrashuvi
board: A: We missed the deadline.
B: If we had started earlier, we'd be finished now.
A: Unless we finish today, we'll lose the client.
scenes.say_native: Ikkinchi dialog ish joyidan. Ikki hamkasb loyiha muddatini o‘tkazib yubordi. Ularning gapida o‘tmishdagi sabab va hozirgi oqibat, ya’ni aralash shart bor. Shuningdek, kelajak uchun real ogohlantirish ham. Tinglang va nima uchun ular muammoda ekanini aniqlang.
scenes.say: We missed the deadline. I know. If we had started earlier, we would be finished now. Unless we finish today, we will lose the client. Then let's work late, provided the manager approves the overtime. Otherwise we will have to ask for an extension.
scenes.say_uz: Muddatni o‘tkazib yubordik. Bilaman. Ertaroq boshlaganimizda, hozir tugatgan bo‘lardik. Bugun tugatmasak, mijozni yo‘qotamiz. Unda kech qolib ishlaymiz, agar menejer qo‘shimcha ish vaqtiga ruxsat bersa. Aks holda muddatni uzaytirishni so‘raymiz.

scenes.title: Dialog 2 bo‘yicha savollar
board: 1) Why aren't they finished now?
2) What will happen unless they finish today?
3) What is the plan if the manager refuses?
scenes.say_native: Ikkinchi dialog bo‘yicha savollar. Birinchi: nega ular hozir ishni tugatmagan? Ikkinchi: bugun tugatmasalar nima bo‘ladi? Uchinchi: menejer rad etsa, ularning rejasi nima? Qisqa javob bering.
scenes.say: One: why aren't they finished? Two: what happens unless they finish today? Three: what is the plan if the manager does not approve?
scenes.say_uz: Bir: nega tugatmagan? Ikki: bugun tugatmasa nima bo‘ladi? Uch: menejer rozi bo‘lmasa, reja nima?

scenes.title: Dialog 2 javoblari
board: 1) They didn't start early enough.
2) They'll lose the client.
3) They will ask for an extension.
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Birinchi: ular ertaroq boshlamadi, shuning uchun hozir tugatmagan. Bu aralash shart: o‘tmishdagi sabab, hozirgi natija. Ikkinchi: unless ishlatilgan real shart bilan, bugun tugatishmasa, mijoz ketadi. Uchinchi: otherwise dan keyin ularning zaxira rejasi: muddatni uzaytirishni so‘rash. Dialogda nafaqat grammatika, balki ish joyida tabiiy gapirish ham mashq qilindi.
scenes.say: They did not start early. They will lose the client. Otherwise, they will ask for an extension.
scenes.say_uz: Ular ertaroq boshlamagan. Mijozni yo‘qotadilar. Aks holda muddatni uzaytirishni so‘raydilar.

scenes.title: Talaffuz: 'd, would've, hadn't
board: I'd /aɪd/ = I had YOKI I would
would've /ˈwʊdəv/
hadn't /ˈhædnt/

examples.t: I'd known. (I had known)
I'd go. (I would go)

scenes.say_native: Og‘zaki nutqda shart gaplar qisqartmalar bilan aytiladi. I'd ham I had, ham I would bo‘lishi mumkin. Qaysi ekanini keyingi so‘z aniqlaydi: I'd known, I'd studied bu had, chunki uchinchi shakl keladi. I'd go, I'd help bu would, chunki asosiy fe’l keladi. Would have tez nutqda would've /ˈwʊdəv/ bo‘ladi, ba’zilar uni xato ravishda would of deb yozadi. Buni yozmada hech qachon qilmang.
scenes.say: If I'd known, I'd have told you. I'd go if I could. I would've called.
scenes.say_uz: Bilganimda, aytgan bo‘lardim. Iloji bo‘lsa, borardim. Qo‘ng‘iroq qilgan bo‘lardim.

scenes.title: Eshitib ayting
board: If I'd known, I'd have told you.
She wouldn't have gone.
I'd go if I could.
scenes.say_native: Endi talaffuzni mashq qiling. Har bir gapni tez, qisqartmalar bilan ayting. Birinchida I'd ikki xil ma’noda ketma-ket keladi: avval had, keyin would. Would have so‘zida have ni deyarli eshitilmas qilib, /əv/ deb ayting. Ikkinchi gapda wouldn't have tezlashadi. Takrorlang.
scenes.say: If I'd known, I'd have told you. She wouldn't have gone. I'd go if I could.
scenes.say_uz: Bilganimda, aytgan bo‘lardim. U bormagan bo‘lardi. Iloji bo‘lsa, borardim.

scenes.title: Talaffuz izohi
board: I'd known /aɪd nəʊn/
I'd have /aɪd əv/
wouldn't have /ˈwʊdnt əv/
scenes.say_native: Izoh. Tez nutqda have kuchsiz shaklga o‘tadi: /əv/. Shuning uchun would have tinglovchi uchun “wudəv” kabi eshitiladi. Tinglab tushunish mashqida bu juda muhim: ko‘p o‘quvchilar “would of” eshitgandek bo‘ladi. Agar siz bu qisqartmalarni o‘zingiz ham shunday ayta olsangiz, tabiiy va ravon eshitilasiz. Lekin yozma ishda har doim to‘liq have ni yozing.
scenes.say: Weak forms make speech natural. Would have sounds like wudəv, but we always write have.
scenes.say_uz: Kuchsiz shakllar nutqni tabiiy qiladi. Would have eshitilishda wudəv bo‘ladi, lekin yozmada doim have yozamiz.

scenes.title: Yakuniy vazifa: qaror va oqibat
board: Speak for 30 seconds:
1) a past decision
2) its effect now
3) a regret
scenes.say_native: Yakuniy nutq vazifasi. O‘tmishdagi bir muhim qarorni tanlang: o‘qish, ish, ko‘chish yoki sayohat. 30 soniya gapiring. Avval qarorni, keyin uning bugungi oqibatini, so‘ng afsus yoki xursandchilikni ayting. Kamida bitta third conditional, bitta mixed conditional va bitta I wish ishlating. Hozir boshlang.
scenes.say: Think of an important decision in your past. Describe it, say how it affects you now, and say what you might have done differently.
scenes.say_uz: O‘tmishdagi muhim qaroringizni o‘ylang. Uni tasvirlang, bugungi ta’sirini ayting va boshqacha nima qilishingiz mumkinligini ayting.

scenes.title: Namunaviy javob
board: I moved to the capital at 18.
If I hadn't moved, I wouldn't have met her.
I wish I had learned English earlier.
scenes.say_native: Namuna keltiramiz. “At eighteen I moved to the capital. If I hadn't moved, I wouldn't have met my wife. If I had stayed at home, I would be working in my father's shop now. Honestly, I wish I had started English earlier, but I'm glad I made that decision.” Ko‘rdingizmi: uchta turdagi tuzilma bitta kichik hikoyada. Sizning javobingizda ham shunday uchlik bo‘lsa, vazifa a’lo bajarilgan.
scenes.say: At eighteen I moved to the capital. If I hadn't moved, I wouldn't have met my wife. If I had stayed, I would be working in my father's shop now. I wish I had started English earlier.
scenes.say_uz: O‘n sakkizda poytaxtga ko‘chdim. Ko‘chmaganimda, rafiqam bilan uchrashmagan bo‘lardim. Qolganimda, hozir otamning do‘konida ishlardim. Ingliz tilini ertaroq boshlaganimda edi.

scenes.title: Takrorlash
board: Second: if + past, would
Third: if + had V3, would have V3
Mixed: had V3 → would (now) / past → would have
Alternatives: provided, unless, otherwise, in case
scenes.say_native: Qisqacha takrorlaymiz. Second conditional: if va o‘tgan zamon, would. Third conditional: if had va uchinchi shakl, would have. Aralash shartlar: o‘tmish sababi hozirgi natija uchun had va would, hozirgi holat o‘tmish natija uchun o‘tgan zamon va would have. If o‘rniga provided, unless, otherwise va in case. Afsus va tanqid uchun I wish, if only va should have. Siz bularning hammasini bugun mashq qildingiz.
scenes.say: Remember: second is imaginary present, third is imaginary past, and mixed conditionals connect them. Also use provided, unless, otherwise and in case.
scenes.say_uz: Eslab qoling: second xayoliy hozir, third xayoliy o‘tmish, aralash shartlar ularni bog‘laydi. Provided, unless, otherwise va in case ni ham ishlating.

scenes.title: Homework
board: Write 8 sentences about past decisions and their effects.
Use third, mixed, I wish and unless.
scenes.say_native: Uy vazifasi: o‘tmishdagi qarorlaringiz va ularning oqibatlari haqida sakkizta gap yozing. Kamida ikkitasi third conditional, ikkitasi aralash shart, bittadan I wish va should have, bittasi unless yoki provided bilan bo‘lsin. Muvaffaqiyat mezoni: har bir gapda zamonlar to‘g‘ri va ma’no sizning haqiqiy hayotingizga mos. Keyingi darsda ish va karyera lug‘atini o‘rganamiz.
scenes.say: Your homework is to write eight sentences about past decisions and their effects. Next time we study work and career vocabulary.
scenes.say_uz: Uy vazifangiz: o‘tmishdagi qarorlar va ularning oqibatlari haqida sakkizta gap yozing. Keyingi darsda ish va karyera lug‘atini o‘rganamiz.

homework_uz: O‘tmishdagi qarorlaringiz va ularning oqibatlari haqida 8 ta gap yozing. Kamida 2 ta third conditional, 2 ta aralash shart, 1 ta I wish, 1 ta should have va 1 ta unless yoki provided ishlating. Muvaffaqiyat mezoni: barcha zamonlar to‘g‘ri va gaplar sizning haqiqiy hayotingizga mos.

options: If it will rain, we'll stay in.
If it rains, we'll stay in.
If it rained, we'll stay in.
If it would rain, we'll stay in.
quiz.why_uz: Birinchi shartda if dan keyin hozirgi oddiy zamon: If it rains, we'll stay in.

quiz.q: If I ___ you, I would accept the offer.
quiz.why_uz: If I were you — maslahat qolipi; if dan keyin were ishlatiladi.

quiz.q: If I ___ known, I would have helped.
quiz.why_uz: Third conditional shart qismida had + V3: If I had known.

quiz.q: Which sentence is a correct third conditional?
options: If she studied, she would pass.
If she had studied, she would have passed.
If she would study, she would pass.
If she has studied, she passes.
quiz.why_uz: Third: if + had + V3, would have + V3.

quiz.q: If I had taken that job, I ___ rich now.
quiz.why_uz: Aralash shart: o‘tmish sabab, hozirgi natija — would + asosiy fe’l.

quiz.q: If I spoke Spanish, I ___ the job last year.
quiz.why_uz: Hozirgi doimiy holat, o‘tmish natija: if + past, would have + V3.

quiz.q: You can use my car ___ you drive carefully.
Hurry up, ___ you'll miss the bus.
Take a coat ___ it gets cold later.
Which sentence expresses regret about the past correctly?
options: I wish I would study more.
I wish I had studied more.
I wish I studied more yesterday.
I wish I have studied more.
quiz.why_uz: O‘tmish afsusi: I wish + had + V3.
